notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Halana triggers, causing you to pay {2} to have that creature deal damage equal to its power to Polyraptor.
Polyraptor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Polyraptor, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Polyraptor trigger, creating a token copy of it.
When the Polyraptor token enters the battlefield, Halana triggers, causing you to pay {2} to have the Polyraptor token deal damage equal to its power to itself.
Repeat from step 3.
